title: custom:heading-card-pro
description: A heading with an icon, a subtitle and live badges, without a card around it.

style.description: section: small caps and a line; title and subtitle as Home Assistant's heading; big: a larger title beside the icon in a circle; hero: a greeting's size

subtitle.description: The line under the title. Template allowed.

icon.description: The icon before the title. Template allowed.

color.description: The icon's colour (default: secondary text, big: primary). Template allowed.

title_tap_action.description: Action when the title or its icon is tapped, e.g. navigate to the room's dashboard (default: none)

icon_tap_action.description: Action when the icon is tapped, instead of the title's (default: none)

align.description: center: the title, the subtitle and the badges centred

badges_position.description: Where the badges sit: at the end of the line (below it on a narrow card), right after the title, or on a line of their own

overflow.description: More badges than fit: wrap onto more lines, or scroll on one

badge_style.description: The pill of every badge that names none

badge_size.description: The size of every badge that names none
